title_en: QUAKE — INSIGHT & THE INSIDE OF MARS
description: An interactive field guide to NASA's InSight lander (2018–2022): the SEIS seismometer under its wind and thermal shield, 1,319 marsquakes and the magnitude 4.7 S1222a, meteoroid impacts heard by SEIS and found by MRO, the crust, mantle and a liquid core revised from 1,830 km to about 1,650–1,675 km, the HP³ mole that could not dig, and the dust that ended the mission.
og: Weigh a marsquake, send rays through a layered Mars to find the core's shadow, see why InSight's mole had no grip, and watch dust drain the solar panels: InSight's four years on Mars, interactive and checked against the mission's published results.
brand: QUAKE — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
